data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word لزل (Lazal) meaning gentle, soft, and beautiful. In nature, it represents the gentle rustling of leaves and the softness of flowers. The name Layzal carries the meaning “Gentle, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Layzal usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
